name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
summary: Income support for eligible farmer families, paid in instalments. The portal reports suspected exclusion cases and advises beneficiaries to check their status.

benefitDetails.amount: ₹6,000 per year, subject to current eligibility and scheme rules

eligibilitySummary: Eligible farmer families, subject to landholding, exclusion criteria, and current government rules. Verify the applicant's status on the official portal.
applicationRoute: Use the official PM-KISAN portal or visit the local agriculture office / Common Service Centre for assistance.
verificationNotes: Portal accessible during collection. Confirm current eligibility and instalment status for each applicant.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
summary: Crop insurance programme for notified crops and areas against covered crop-loss risks.

benefitDetails.amount: Claim depends on notified crop, insured area, sum insured, and assessed loss

eligibilitySummary: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas during the notified season; enrolment windows and conditions vary by season and state.
applicationRoute: Check the current season and district notification on the official PMFBY portal; enrolment routes can include banks, approved channels, or the portal.
verificationNotes: Portal accessible. Check current Tamil Nadu crop/district notification and application deadline before advising.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana – Per Drop More Crop
summary: Supports improved farm-level water-use efficiency, particularly micro-irrigation such as drip and sprinkler systems.

benefitDetails.amount: Assistance varies by applicant category and current state guidelines

eligibilitySummary: Farmers and land parcels meeting the current state implementation rules; verify crop, area, equipment, and applicant-category conditions.
applicationRoute: Check with the Tamil Nadu Agriculture / Horticulture Department or local block agriculture office for current application and approved suppliers.
verificationNotes: Central programme information checked; current Tamil Nadu subsidy rates and application availability were not confirmed.

name: Soil Health Card
summary: Soil testing and nutrient-management information to help farmers make informed fertilizer and soil-management decisions.

benefitDetails.amount: Not a cash subsidy

eligibilitySummary: Farmers can seek soil testing and card information through designated state agriculture channels; local sampling arrangements may vary.
applicationRoute: Use the official portal or contact the local agriculture extension office for soil sampling and card availability.

officialSources.sourceType: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University extension portal
supports: Tamil Nadu crop and agriculture guidance

verificationNotes: Portal reachable; local sampling and service availability should be confirmed.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) – Agriculture
summary: Bank credit facility intended to meet eligible farmers' cultivation and related working-capital needs.

benefitDetails.amount: Credit limit and interest terms depend on bank assessment and current rules

eligibilitySummary: Eligible farmers and other categories recognized under current KCC guidelines; the lending bank determines documentation and sanctioned limit.
applicationRoute: Apply through a participating bank or seek help from the local agriculture office / Common Service Centre.
verificationNotes: A single authoritative KCC application page was not confirmed in this collection. Do not promise a loan or interest benefit.

name: PM-KUSUM

benefitDetails.amount: Component, applicant contribution, subsidy and application window must be checked in current Tamil Nadu notifications

eligibilitySummary: Depends on component, applicant type, location, and current state allocation.

verificationNotes: Current Tamil Nadu component availability and subsidy rates were not confirmed.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
summary: Rural wage-employment programme; works can include locally approved natural-resource and community-asset activities.

benefitDetails.amount: Wage rates and work availability depend on current state notifications and approved works

eligibilitySummary: Rural household members meeting the Act's requirements and seeking unskilled manual work; job-card and work-demand processes apply.
applicationRoute: Contact the Gram Panchayat / local programme officer; use the official portal for programme information and records.
verificationNotes: Official portal redirects to the current MGNREGA site. Local wage rate and work demand must be checked locally.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
summary: Rural livelihoods mission that organizes and supports eligible rural households through self-help groups and livelihood institutions.

benefitDetails.amount: Support varies by activity, group, and state implementation

eligibilitySummary: Rural households participating through eligible SHGs and mission institutions; local selection and support vary.
applicationRoute: Contact the local SHG federation, block mission management unit, or Tamil Nadu rural livelihoods mission office.

supports: Rural Development and Panchayat Raj Department

verificationNotes: Tamil Nadu department homepage was reachable, but programme-specific details were not extracted. Verify local implementation and contact.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
summary: Rural housing programme for eligible households selected under current programme rules and verified beneficiary processes.

benefitDetails.amount: Assistance depends on current guidelines, location, and approved beneficiary status

eligibilitySummary: Households meeting current rural housing eligibility and selection criteria; inclusion must be confirmed against official beneficiary records.
applicationRoute: Check with the Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office and official PMAY-G records.
verificationNotes: Direct portal access was unavailable during this collection. Confirm current site, eligibility and assistance locally before advising.

name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
summary: Supports eligible livestock entrepreneurship and related activities, including specified sheep, goat, pig, poultry, and feed/fodder activities under current mission components.

benefitDetails.amount: Component-specific; verify current eligible project, subsidy ceiling, applicant contribution and application window

name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organisations (FPOs)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)

benefitDetails.amount: Pension benefit and contribution depend on age and current scheme rules

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)

verificationNotes: Check the currently supported crop, activity, and district before describing a benefit as available.
